title: Listen: Is Europe ready to defend itself against cyberattacks?
lede: Bomb threats, election interference, espionage, and sabotage. Cyberattacks are becoming an increasingly serious threat across Europe, affecting everything from public services to critical infrastructure. So, how prepared is Europe to deal with them?
